Painter in the French Alps, former field researcher on the Juneau Icefield, Stanford-trained: Lisa Cirenza's statement, long bio and short bio for press.
Selected CV of Lisa Cirenza: Stanford University, Juneau Icefield Research Program, Stanford Hospital collection, Grand Palais Paris, Personal Structures in Venice, art fairs and talks.

Hire Espace Créa-Tea-Vité in La Clusaz for private events, dinners, receptions and art-thinking team building: up to 18 guests seated, 40 standing.
Two painting retreats with Lisa Cirenza in La Clusaz in 2027: Painting in Paradise (21 – 26 June) and Alpine Creative Pause (6 – 11 September). Small groups, from €2,450.
Bespoke art sessions with Lisa Cirenza for individuals, families, groups, teams and event planners in La Clusaz: wax and mixed media, monoprinting, the artist's eye, abstraction, iPad art.
Why Lisa Cirenza paints glaciers and melt: the story behind A Record of Time, the works on her easel, research and process in encaustic.
Available works by Lisa Cirenza: original encaustics, archival prints printed and shipped by creativehub, and collectors' editions in acrylic.
Ask about a work, a retreat, a private course or an event: write to Lisa Cirenza or visit Espace Créa-Tea-Vité, 27 Passage du Mont Blanc, La Clusaz.
Visit the Espace Créa-Tea-Vité boutique and tea room in La Clusaz: art materials and local gifts, signature lattes, hot cocoa and teas. Opening hours, map and parking.
Work on your own creative projects with personalised guidance from Lisa Cirenza, a warm drink included, at Espace Créa-Tea-Vité in La Clusaz. €30 per session.
La Gravité de la Grâce, December 2026 – April 2027 at Espace Créa-Tea-Vité, La Clusaz: Lisa Cirenza's new series, photographs by Le Petit Lapin and steel sculptures by BNT Designs.
